models.name: todo_app_users

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for authentication. Must be a valid email format. This is the user's primary identifier for login.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Cryptographically hashed password for secure authentication. Generated using bcrypt or equivalent algorithm upon registration.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created. Always present and immutable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the account. Updated on password change or profile modification request.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when user initiated account deletion. Soft delete implementation. If null, account is active.

models.name: todo_app_user_sessions
models.description: Stores login sessions for todo_app_users. Each entry represents a successful authentication event with connection metadata. This table is append-only and used for audit trails and token validation. Never directly modified by users - managed exclusively by authentication service. {@link todo_app_users.id}

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: The authenticated user this session belongs to. {@link todo_app_users.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: The IP address from which the user logged in. Used for security auditing.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: The full URL the user was accessing when initiating the session, for context in authentication events.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: The referrer URL that led the user to this application, captured for analytics.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session was created. Always recorded at authentication.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session expires and is no longer valid for authentication. Must be set and is not nullable.

models.name: todo_app_user_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset token and expiration for secure account recovery. Each token is tied to a user and expires after a defined duration. When used, the token is invalidated and removed. Reset requests are immutable after creation.

@link todo_app_users.id

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: User who requested the password reset. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique, random, cryptographic token used to reset password. Must be long, random, and unguessable.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this token expires and becomes invalid. After this time, the token must no longer be accepted.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was generated.

models.name: todo_app_password_reset_tokens
models.description:
Stores password reset tokens for user authentication. Each token is a cryptographically secure random string that grants temporary access to reset a user's password. Tokens have a short expiration lifetime (typically 1 hour) after which they become invalid. This table ensures secure, time-bound password recovery without storing passwords or exposing sensitive data. This table's stance is session because it represents an authentication event tied directly to the user actor, not an independent business entity.

Relationship: {@link todo_app_users}

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: The user to whom this password reset token belongs. {@link todo_app_users.id}

foreignFields.name: token
foreignFields.description: Unique, cryptographically secure token string used to authenticate password reset requests.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was generated.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token expires and becomes invalid. Typically set 1 hour after created_at.

models.name: todo_app_user_deletion_requests
models.description: Manages pending user account deletion requests with timestamp and status, ensuring orderly cleanup of all associated data. Each entry links to a user_id from todo_app_users and records when the deletion was requested and the current status of the request (e.g., "pending", "confirmed", "completed"). No personal data is stored beyond the user_id, preserving strict privacy. This table is critical for the account deletion workflow and is referenced during cleanup of todos, profiles, and sessions after confirmation.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the user who requested account deletion. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_profile_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the user's profile at time of deletion request. {@link todo_app_profiles.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the deletion request. Must be one of: "pending", "confirmed", or "completed". Tracks stage of account deletion workflow.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the deletion request was initially submitted by the user.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the deletion request status was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the deletion was fully completed and user data was purged. Nullable: indicates pending or active deletion state.

models.name: todo_app_profiles
models.description:
Stores the current display name for each authenticated user, linked by user_id. Includes creation and last edit timestamps. Ensures privacy by isolating profile data from todos and authentication.

This table is the canonical source for user display names. Each user has exactly one profile. The profile is edited independently of authentication credentials stored in todo_app_users. All profile updates are tracked in todo_app_profile_edits, but only the current value is stored here. The table enforces strict privacy: no user can view another user's display name or profile through any API endpoint.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: The associated authenticated user's identifier. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: The user's chosen display name for UI presentation. Must be 1-32 characters, alphanumeric and spaces only. This is the only identifier visible to the user in the interface. Cannot be null, as all authenticated users must have a display name.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this profile was created. This records when the user first set their display name upon account creation or first login.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent edit to this profile (i.e., display name change). This is updated by application logic whenever the user changes their display name.

models.name: todo_app_profile_edits

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the user who made the display name change. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: original_display_name
plainFields.description: The display name value before the change. May be empty if the display name was set for the first time.

plainFields.name: new_display_name
plainFields.description: The display name value after the change. Cannot be empty as profile must have a display name.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the display name change was recorded. Always set.

models.name: todo_app_todos
models.description:
Represents todos that have been soft-deleted by the user and are stored in trash. These todos retain all original data including title, description, start date, due date, and completion status. A non-null deleted_at indicates the todo is in trash; setting deleted_at to null restores it. Permanent deletion purges the record entirely. All todos belong to exactly one user and are completely private.

The todo_app_todos table serves both as the main todo entity and the trash container. Trash is not a separate table but a state of this table, controlled by the deleted_at field. Users can restore a todo by setting deleted_at to null, or permanently delete it to remove the record. The edit history of these todos is stored separately in todo_app_todo_histories.

Linked to todo_app_users via user_id for data isolation and ownership.

This model is classified as 'primary' because users directly interact with todos in trash: they can view, restore, and permanently delete items from trash, making it a core part of the todo lifecycle independent of other entities.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: The user who owns this todo. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Required title of the todo. Maximum length 255 characters.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed description of the todo. Can be empty.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Optional start date for the todo in ISO 8601 format. If null, the todo has no start date.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date for the todo in ISO 8601 format. If null, the todo has no due date.

plainFields.name: completed
plainFields.description: Whether the todo is complete or incomplete. Defaults to false when created.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was created. Immutable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was last updated. Updated on every edit.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was soft-deleted (moved to trash). If null, the todo is active and not in trash. Must be non-null for todos in trash.
